name: messaging-by-agent-messenger
description: Read WhatsApp, Telegram, and LinkedIn chats and send WhatsApp replies from one messaging inbox.

interface.longDescription:
Messaging by Agent Messenger brings WhatsApp, Telegram, and LinkedIn conversations into ChatGPT. Read recent chats, review message history, summarize discussions, and prepare WhatsApp replies with help from your AI assistant. Catch up on customer messages, team conversations, and professional contacts from one messaging inbox across three apps. Compare recent conversations across apps and turn retrieved messages into a clear list of next steps.

READ CHATS ACROSS THREE PLATFORMS
Find the accounts you have connected, check their connection status, and ask for recent conversations. Open a chat to read its messages and understand the context before deciding what to do next. Ask ChatGPT to summarize a discussion, extract questions, identify follow-up tasks, or help draft a response based on the messages retrieved. Keep track of conversations across your WhatsApp inbox, Telegram chats, and LinkedIn messages without manually copying each exchange into ChatGPT.

WHATSAPP MESSAGES, REPLIES, AND CONTACTS
Review your latest WhatsApp chats and read conversation history. Find a WhatsApp contact by name, nickname, or phone number, then ask your assistant to prepare a reply. Send the text you approve from your connected WhatsApp number, or share an image with an optional caption. Add and organize contacts, rename contacts added in Agent Messenger, and use contact tags to keep customer groups and follow-up lists organized. Useful for customer support, sales follow-ups, client communication, appointment coordination, and everyday messaging.

TELEGRAM CHATS AND MESSAGE HISTORY
List your connected Telegram accounts, check whether an account is online, and browse recently active chats. Read messages in a selected conversation and ask ChatGPT to summarize the context, pull out action items, or explain what needs your attention. Telegram access in this app covers chat reading and account status; it does not send Telegram messages.

LINKEDIN CONVERSATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL MESSAGES
Review recent LinkedIn conversations and read messages from your connected account. Catch up on professional discussions, recruiting conversations, client questions, and networking follow-ups. Ask ChatGPT to help understand a conversation or draft a response for you to use yourself. This app does not send LinkedIn messages. LinkedIn history is limited to the latest 200 messages per conversation, and provider rate limits can require waiting before another read.

WHATSAPP MESSAGING CAMPAIGNS
Create a draft WhatsApp campaign for selected contacts or tagged groups. Review the audience and message, then start delivery or schedule a future start after approval. Messages are paced with a delay between recipients. Track campaign progress and recipient delivery status, and pause, resume, or cancel campaigns when needed. Use campaigns for updates and follow-ups with recipients who expect to hear from you.

TRY THESE PROMPTS
"Show my recent WhatsApp, Telegram, and LinkedIn chats."
"Summarize the latest messages in my Telegram conversation."
"Read my LinkedIn conversation and list the questions I need to answer."
"Find my WhatsApp contact and draft a reply for me to approve."
"Show the delivery status of my WhatsApp campaign."

YOU CONTROL ACCESS AND SENDING
Choose separate read, manage, and send permissions when connecting. Multi-recipient direct WhatsApp messages require a preview of the exact recipients and text before delivery. Approve campaign messages, recipients, and timing before starting or scheduling delivery. Sent messages cannot be recalled. Opening LinkedIn chats can mark them read and send read receipts; resolving a chat may also mark other unread chats read. Tool calls are recorded in your account's audit history.

Messaging by Agent Messenger is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to LinkedIn, Telegram, or WhatsApp. The LinkedIn, Telegram, and WhatsApp names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

positive.description: Find the connected accounts for each supported messaging platform.
positive.prompt: Show the WhatsApp, Telegram, and LinkedIn accounts connected to my messaging inbox.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer account’s connected WhatsApp, Telegram, and LinkedIn accounts and their available account identifiers without sending or changing a message.

positive.description: Read the recent WhatsApp conversation with a seeded demo contact.
positive.prompt: Show my recent WhatsApp chats, then read the five newest messages with Demo Recipient.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the demo WhatsApp account and chat, then returns up to five messages from that conversation without sending a reply.

positive.description: Read the recent Telegram conversation on the seeded demo account.
positive.prompt: Show my recent Telegram chats and read the five newest messages in the latest chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the connected demo Telegram account to list recent chats and read up to five messages in the latest chat without sending any Telegram message.

positive.description: Read the recent LinkedIn conversation on the seeded demo account.
positive.prompt: Show my recent LinkedIn conversations and read the five newest messages in the latest conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent conversations and reads up to five messages in the latest conversation after disclosing that opening chats may mark them read and send read receipts. Does not compose or send a LinkedIn message.

positive.description: Send one WhatsApp reply to a consenting demo recipient controlled for review.
positive.prompt: Find Demo Recipient on WhatsApp and send this exact reply now: Review test: hello from Agent Messenger.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the seeded demo WhatsApp recipient, sends the exact requested text once to that chat, and reports the result.

negative.prompt: Send “hello” to my latest Telegram chat.
